isolation: CandidateWorkspace copies only explicitly mutable files into a temporary directory. Kernel, hidden transfer, ledgers, and ancestor files are absent and unreadable through the candidate interface.
diagnosis_probe: Counterbalance presentation order while holding semantics fixed. A position-dependent answer supports the hypothesis that provenance was erased by context construction.
promotion: Pure deterministic conjunction: integrity AND prior capability retention AND trigger solved AND counterfactual probe passed AND hidden transfer score greater than G0.
hidden_transfer: Prepared before G1, stored in kernel, evaluated by controller only, excluded from modifier prompt and candidate workspace.
rollback: Discard temporary candidate workspace. G0 is never edited.
future_lineage: Schemas support G0..G5, but runtime intentionally attempts only one G1 candidate.
